profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Cloud & AI Solutions Architect | Expert in SDLC, Agile, and Test-Driven Development | Specializing in Automation, Debugging, and Cloud Computing
profile.summary:
As a professional, I specialize in transforming complex business challenges into innovative systems and solutions aligned seamlessly with organizational needs. This has included comprehensive experience in the software development lifecycle, cloud computing, AI, and agile methodologies.

I excel in leveraging cross-functional collaboration and communication to drive success and ensure maximum customer and stakeholder satisfaction. This has included end-to-end, full stack development life cycles as well as the review, debugging, and refactoring of outdated code.

I am always eager to seek out new challenges where I can drive excellence and continuously improve performance while integrating emerging technologies. Please connect with me on LinkedIn if you feel your organization’s mission can benefit from my achievements and qualifications.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on a specialized customer service team that supports developers creating Slack applications by building, testing, and debugging application systems.
• Demonstrated high technical skill through creating test applications in different object oriented programming languages, amplifying application development knowledge through public-facing repos, and communicating effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional partners.
• Analyzed PHP source code, HTTP logs, and API logs as a Slack API specialist to diagnose and solve errors and roadblocks.
• Assisted customers with issues related to AI Agent deployments to Slack.
• Studied and shared best practices for utilizing Slack APIs and webhooks.
• Demonstrated authoritative knowledge on OAuth 2.0 by creating educational materials for the team.
positions.insights: Skills: OAuth · SQL · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · PHP · API Documentation · Debugging · Ticketing Systems · Git

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on a dedicated team supporting the highest tiered and most reputable Google Workspace customers, Enterprise and Platinum customers. 
• Investigated customer issues through log analysis, troubleshooting, and internal tools to diagnose and fix product issues and bugs.
• Identified out-of-date product support documentation and assisted in making amends to articles utilized by millions of users and agents.

positions.title: .NET Application Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on a team whose responsibility is to provide secure and masked PHI test data that upholds compliance with HIPAA privacy laws.
• Assisted in moving development from manual testing into automated testing solutions, utilizing Selenium and BlazeMeter for automated batch and UI application testing.
• Created extensive documentation in the form of PDFs, Word docs, and tutorial videos on source control, the in-house automation framework, BlazeMeter, and other topics for expedient QA analyst onboarding.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · JavaScript · Language Integrated Query (LINQ) · .NET Framework · C# · MySQL · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET MVC · XML · Test Automation · xUnit

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Demonstrated an ability to construct APIs, implement the MVC model, create responsive web layouts, and write, run, and debug .NET applications.
• Worked on several teams utilizing the Agile/Scrum methodologies to produce applications quickly and efficiently.
• Assumed a leadership position in the creation of an API microservice.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Language Integrated Query (LINQ) · .NET Framework · C# · MySQL · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET MVC · Linux · XML · Docker

positions.title: Full-stack Developer in Residence
positions.description:
• Passed both exams which require building CRUD applications from wireframes in under 5 hours in my first attempt, earning the highest score (black belt) in both of them.
• Was one of only 7 students out of 22 in my Python cohort to pass the exam the first time.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Language Integrated Query (LINQ) · C# · MySQL · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET MVC · Full-Stack Development · XML · ASP.NET Core · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Resident Assistant | Hall Council Executive Staff | Student Leader
positions.description:
• Served as the chair of a newly resurrected organization to helm its reappearance on campus for those in need of a space for transgender-identified students and faculty. 
• Held an executive position in hall council for addressing and implementing diversity education. 
• Coordinated and conducted multi-cultural environments for building community among students on a campus-wide scale.

honors.description: Awarded for performance in UCSB's Gamelan ensemble, that of which I have performed in for 9 quarters.

honors.title: Rising Trans* Leader
honors.description: Nominated by my peers for leadership and activism, most notably for my role in reviving and running an unknown yet essential space for the transgender community on campus, the Transgender Social Group, and establishing it as an official OSL organization.

projects.title: Emotion and Epic Fantasy Music: An Examination of the Epic Compositions of World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King
projects.description: My senior research paper. This essay analyzes musical elements of theme, instrumentation, and compositional conventions used in the video game World of Warcraft. By doing so, I make conclusions about how the soundtrack of World of Warcraft (and by extension, fantasy music) invokes immersion, emotion, and involvement in listeners. It's a passion project as much as it is an academic research assignment as I aim to find the answers to why I, like many others, am so fond of epic video game music.
